patches.decision_note: Identifying the frontend folder for the Flutter source does not claim delivery of the complete web, application, administrative, and backend codebase.
Existing developer-account ownership is release handoff logistics and does not modify the required Google Play release artifact or behavior.

Message 31 introduces only a generic mobile app; review the adjacent platform context to determine whether it target-entails separate Android and iOS INTRODUCE Events or whether both current Events should be deleted.

Email OTP is retained as an identifiable Requirement but has no Event; inspect the raw exchange for a target-explicit INTRODUCE while avoiding any unconfirmed provider or administrator-configuration attributes.
